description: Check one to six brand or business name ideas at once against live U.S. federal trademark filings, plus whether the .com and .co are registered. Use when the user is brainstorming, choosing or comparing names for a brand, shop, product or business. Returns facts only (exact, close and similar filings, closest marks, domains), never a legal opinion.

names.description: The name ideas, one per item, e.g. ["Snoutlove", "Wagwell"].
